scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w apps/ui && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/memory-mcp
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w packages/memory-contract && npm run build -w packages/client && npm run bundle -w packages/client
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run db:setup -w apps/memory-mcp && concurrently -n memory,api,ui "npm run start:dev -w apps/memory-mcp" "npm run start:dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/ui"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/memory-contract && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/memory-mcp && npm run typecheck -w packages/client
